intro: On your turn (clockwise from Agekeeper), take any actions below in any order, as many times as you like. Pass when you are done.

children.label: Craft Astral House
children.body: Spend 3 Spread cards whose Planets match your Sign's ruling Planet. Build the House on your Sign. Each House is a permanent Harvest Source.

children.label: Upgrade to Mansion
children.body: Spend 2 more cards of that Sign's ruling Planet and place a Reagent from the supply beneath the House token as a marker (not spent from your stock).

children.label: Distill a Reagent
children.body: Spend 5 Essence of one Element to take 1 Reagent of that Element from the supply.

children.label: Trade
children.body: Freely exchange Adept Cards, Astral Houses, Essence, Kismeta Cards, and Reagents with any rival on your turn.

children.label: Duel
children.body: Challenge a rival to a Zodiac Die roll. Highest roll wins (defender wins ties). Winner takes a card from the loser's Spread.

children.label: Extinguish Coal
children.body: Use a card effect to remove a rival's Coal from a Furnace, dropping their Heat by 1.

children.label: Siege the Forge
children.body: Attack a rival's Stone while it sits exposed in the Forge. Pay an Ante of Reagents equal to the Shield Reagents guarding that Stone.
